overall_prep_notes: Total prep time across all 10 assets is approximately 2 hours. The bulk is M3 Double Ten-Frame Mat (one per child = 20+ pages), M5 Fact Family Triangles (30 cards laminated), and M7 Story Problem Cards (18 cards). The two character puppets (Plus and Minnie) should be printed on cardstock for years of reuse. Two-colour counters (M4) are a standard math-kit item; confirm you have ~20 per pair before Lesson 1. Doubles dice (M6) are 1-10 foam dice — order from a standard math-kit supplier if not already in stock.

assets.name: Plus the Pup Puppet
assets.purpose: Paper-bag puppet of Plus the Adding Pup. Used in every lesson, anchors Lesson 1.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, portrait. Front and back of the puppet printed on one sheet, ready to cut and glue to a paper bag.

image_placeholders.description: Plus the Adding Pup puppet template in B&W line-art, ~6in tall. Front side shows a golden-retriever-style puppy face with floppy ears, a friendly smile, and a green '+' bandana. Back side shows the puppy's body. Cut lines indicate where to trim before gluing to a paper bag.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_PLUS_PUPPET_TEMPLATE: keywords (puppet) name what the template shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page on cardstock.
Cut along the cut lines.
Glue front and back to a small paper lunch bag.
Add a small pom-pom for Plus's nose if desired.
Store flat between lessons; the puppet should last a full school year.

assets.name: Minnie the Mouse Puppet
assets.purpose: Paper-bag puppet of Minnie the Minus Mouse. Anchors Lesson 3 and reappears in Lesson 4.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, portrait. Front and back of the puppet printed on one sheet.

image_placeholders.description: Minnie the Minus Mouse puppet template in B&W line-art, ~6in tall. Front side shows a small mouse face with round eyes, whiskers, and a red '-' kerchief tied around the neck. Right paw holds a magnifying glass. Back side shows the body. Cut lines indicate where to trim.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_MINNIE_PUPPET_TEMPLATE: keywords (mouse, puppet) name what the template shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 page on cardstock.
Cut along the cut lines.
Glue front and back to a small paper lunch bag.
Add a tiny black pom-pom for Minnie's nose if desired.
Store flat between lessons; the puppet should last a full school year.

assets.name: Double Ten-Frame Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size mat with two stacked ten-frames. Used for Lesson 1 fact modelling, Lesson 2 make-ten strategy, and Lesson 3 cup-hide game.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, landscape. Top half has a 2x5 ten-frame grid; bottom half has another 2x5 ten-frame grid; thin divider between.

image_placeholders.description: A double ten-frame mat in B&W line-art. Top half shows a 2-row × 5-column grid of empty squares (10 cells), labeled 'TOP'. Bottom half shows an identical grid, labeled 'BOTTOM'. Cell borders are thin solid black lines.
image_placeholders.placement: Centred on the page, full-width landscape.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_DOUBLE_TEN_FRAME: keywords (ten-frame, mat) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 1 mat per child (20+ pages for a class of 20).
Laminate every page so children can use dry-erase markers if desired.
Hand out at the start of Lesson 1; collect at the end of Lesson 3.
Store mats in a labelled folder between lessons.
Optional: print extras for emerging-learner small group review.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per child = 20+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Two-Colour Counters
assets.purpose: Round counters, red on one side and yellow on the other. Used to model addition (red + yellow = combined collection) and subtraction (cup-hide). Standard math-kit item, not printed.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical counters from the classroom math kit. Page is a storage-bag label.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows two stacked counters (one red side up, one yellow side up) with a header 'TWO-COLOUR COUNTERS — 20 per pair'. Decorative dot icons around the border.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_COUNTERS_LABEL: keywords (counters, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Confirm you have a class set of two-colour counters (20 per pair = 200 for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to zip-top bags.
Sort into per-pair bags before Lesson 1.
Have bags ready at the start of Lessons 1, 2, 3, and 4.
Optional: use red and yellow paper circles if you don't have foam counters.
assets.quantity_per_class: 20 counters per pair = 200 for a class of 20.

assets.name: Fact Family Triangles
assets.purpose: Set of 30 laminated triangle cards. Each shows the three numbers of a fact family at the corners and a +/- icon at the centre. Used in Lessons 1 and 3 to build fluency with the four-fact family for any sum to 10.
assets.page_layout: 5 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 6 triangle cards in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A fact-family triangle card in B&W line-art, ~3in tall. Equilateral triangle outline with a number circle at each corner: top corner = sum, bottom-left = first addend, bottom-right = second addend. Centre of the triangle has a small +/- icon. Cut lines around each card.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_TRIANGLE_CARD: keywords (triangle, fact) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 5 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut along cut lines into 30 individual triangle cards.
Sort by sum (5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 — five triangles per sum).
Store in a labelled box; reuse all year for fact-fluency practice.
assets.quantity_per_class: 30 cards per class set; one set serves the whole class.

assets.name: Doubles Dice
assets.purpose: Pair of large foam 1-10 dice. Used in Lesson 2 doubles round (roll once, double the number) and near-doubles round (roll twice, find the near-double). Standard math-kit item.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical foam dice. Page is a storage-bag label.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows two 10-sided dice illustrations with a header 'DOUBLES DICE — 2 per pair (1-10)'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_DICE_LABEL: keywords (dice, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Order a class set of 1-10 foam dice (2 per pair = 20 dice for a class of 20).
Print storage labels; tape to zip-top bags.
Sort into per-pair bags before Lesson 2.
Have bags ready at the start of Lesson 2 only.
Optional: use printable 0-9 paper dice if foam dice are unavailable.
assets.quantity_per_class: 2 dice per pair = 20 dice for a class of 20.

assets.name: Story Problem Cards
assets.purpose: Deck of 18 letter-size story problem cards: 6 change-add-to, 6 change-take-from, 6 part-part-whole. Totals up to 50. Used in Lesson 4 station rotations.
assets.page_layout: 18 half-letter cards across 9 letter pages (2 cards per page). Each card has the story text + a small illustration.

image_placeholders.description: A story-problem card in B&W line-art, ~5.5in × 4in. Top section shows the story text in large readable font (~16pt). Bottom section shows a small illustration matching the story (e.g., Plus with a bowl of treats for change-take-from cards, Lila with two button piles for part-part-whole). Card border is a thick black outline. Card number printed in the bottom-right corner (e.g., 'Card 1 of 18').
image_placeholders.placement: Two cards per letter page, stacked vertically.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M7_STORY_CARD: keywords (story, card) name what the card shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 9 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut each page in half to make 18 individual cards.
Sort by problem type (6 change-add-to, 6 change-take-from, 6 part-part-whole). Colour-code the corner with a sticker if desired.
Distribute 6 cards per station for Lesson 4 rotations.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 deck of 18 cards per class set; serves 3 stations of 6 cards each.

assets.name: Paper Cookies
assets.purpose: Set of ~30 printable paper cookie tokens (chocolate chip, oatmeal, sugar). Some cookies are pre-cut along a half-line so they can split into halves visibly. Used in Lesson 5 fair-share scenarios.
assets.page_layout: 3 letter pages, portrait. Each page holds 10 cookies in a 2x5 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A paper cookie token in B&W line-art, ~2in diameter. Three variants: chocolate chip (round with 5-7 small dark dots), oatmeal (round with rough texture lines), sugar (round with sparkle marks). Some cookies (about 1 in 5) have a dotted half-line through the middle indicating where to cut.
image_placeholders.placement: 10 cookies per page in a 2x5 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M8_COOKIE_CARD: keywords (cookie, token) name what the token shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 3 pages on cardstock.
Laminate every page before cutting.
Cut into 30 individual cookie tokens.
Pre-cut about 6 cookies along the half-line into two visible halves (these are the leftover cookies for the half-share demo).
Store in a labelled bag; refresh annually if tokens get bent.
assets.quantity_per_class: 30 cookies per class set; serves 4-5 groups in Lesson 5.

assets.name: Sharing Paper Plates
assets.purpose: Set of 5 paper plates per group. Used in Lesson 5 to deal cookies into equal groups for 2, 4, or 5 friends.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — real disposable paper plates. Page is a label/instructions sheet.

image_placeholders.description: A storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, in B&W line-art. Shows a stack of 3 paper plates with a header 'SHARING PLATES — 5 per group'. Decorative cookie icons in the corners.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M9_PLATES_LABEL: keywords (plates, label) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Buy a pack of small disposable paper plates (5 per group = ~25-30 for a class of 20 in groups of 4).
Print storage labels; tape to plate stacks if desired.
Sort into per-group sets before Lesson 5.
Have plates ready at the start of Lesson 5 only.
Reuse plates across the week if they stay clean.
assets.quantity_per_class: 5 plates per group = ~25-30 for a class of 20 in groups of 4.

assets.name: The Adding Machine Poster
assets.purpose: Large classroom anchor chart drawn as a friendly machine with input slots on top and an output chute on the bottom, plus reference rows for the four mental strategies. Posted Lesson 1, referenced all week.
assets.page_layout: 1 large-format letter page, portrait — printed at tabloid size if a tabloid printer is available, or assembled from 4 letter pages tiled together for a roughly 17in × 22in poster.

image_placeholders.description: The Adding Machine anchor poster in B&W line-art, ~17in × 22in. Top section shows a friendly mechanical machine with two input slots labeled 'Addend' and 'Addend' and an output chute labeled 'Sum' below. Middle section has 4 strategy rows: Count-On (with a footstep icon), Doubles (twin icon), Near-Doubles (twin+1 icon), Make-Ten (10-frame icon). Bottom section has Plus the Pup and Minnie the Mouse standing beside the machine waving.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M10_MACHINE_POSTER: keywords (machine, poster) name what the poster shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 4 letter pages and tile together OR print 1 tabloid page if available.
Laminate the assembled poster.
Tape to the front classroom wall on Day 1.
Reference the strategy rows during every lesson. Add child-generated examples as the week progresses.
Store rolled at the end of the unit for re-use next year.
